name: Top-Down Rally
how: Race tiny cars around a top-down track. Grass slows you down. Hold drift through a corner and let go for a boost. Three laps, then on to the next track.
controls: Arrow keys or WASD, Shift or Space to drift, or on-screen buttons
uses: The fastest laps on each track.
Races start, finish and move to the next track together for everyone.
Rubber-banded bots fill the grid until enough people join.
Every car moves for everyone at once.
ideas: Add oil slicks that spin cars
Set the track on a kitchen table
Add a lap timer with a ghost of your best lap
